reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system uses a photonics-assisted approach to integrate radar ranging, wireless communications, and spectrum sensing. The system mechanism involves the use of a polarization-multiplexed dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator (PM-DPMZM) to generate a multi-function signal that enables radar ranging and spectrum sensing on one polarization state and wireless communications on the other. The ISAC coupling mode is based on the sharing of hardware and signal level, with de-chirping and spectrum sensing performed in the optical domain using the same hardware platform.
